files.readme:
Aldermoor courier dispatch.

dispatch/   parcel handoff windows for the depot network
routing/    lane planning and driver assignment
ops/        shift notes and on-call rotation

The depot network is owned by the regional logistics desk; routing questions
go to #lane-ops, handoff questions to #depot-ops.

turns.prompt: The depot network's integration notes mention a helper that decides whether a depot is still taking parcel handoffs. A routing engineer preparing a change needs its exact source location. In which file, and on which line, is the function is_handoff_open defined? Give the location as <relative path>:<line number>. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
